messages:
Sam (devex): noticed a weird DX regression after 0.4.0: TS editors no longer find types for imports like `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` and Cloudflare workers sometimes throw 'No matching export'

Leah (eng-runtime): did we change the exports map recently? that combination (explicit subpath + missing typesVersions) can break both runtime and editor resolution.

Sam (devex): published package.json excerpt (from registry): {
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./node": "./dist/node.cjs.js",
    "./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs",
    "./*": "./dist/*.js"
  },
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts"
}

Marcus (eng-ml): yep that shape can leave editors without a subpath type entry. also some runtimes want condition-objects not plain strings.

Ava (devex): quick mitigation: add a root proxy file `edge.mjs` that re-exports dist and add "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" } plus a typesVersions mapping for the `edge` subpath.

Leah (eng-runtime): agree. also add a small npm-pack + worker/bun tsserver test to release CI so we catch this earlier.

CI-bot: sample-apps/workers job failing on main  import-resolution-error linked to sdk@0.4.0

Sam (devex): opening a small PR with proxy file + exports/types fix + a pack-and-resolve smoke test. will publish a canary once green.

(reacts: :eyes: :shipit:)
